page_subtitle: Connect your Cardano wallet, then redeem your Midnight NIGHT on the official portal.
intro: NIGHT redemption is handled by Midnight's official portal. Phoenix only helps you connect and check your address — it never touches your funds.
point_official: Signing happens on the official Midnight portal (redeem.midnight.gd).
point_destination: The address that receives NIGHT was fixed when you claimed — it does NOT need to sign. You never re-enter a recovery phrase or restore a cold wallet.
point_fee: You just need any wallet with a little ADA to pay the fee — that's the signing wallet, not the receiving one. NIGHT still goes to the correct address no matter who pays.
point_thaw: NIGHT unlocks (thaws) in four installments over ~360 days after mainnet launch.
no_wallet: You don't have a Cardano wallet in this browser yet. Install one (e.g. Lace) to use as the fee-paying wallet.
handoff_note: You will finish and sign the redemption on Midnight's official site.
learn_more: Learn more about NIGHT at midnight.gd
connect_slow_hint: No answer from the wallet yet. Its approval window may be hidden behind the browser — open the wallet extension. If the wallet is locked, unlock it first.
connect_timeout: The wallet did not answer. Unlock it, close any approval window left waiting, then try again.
connect_bad_api: That wallet returned an incomplete CIP-30 interface, so it cannot be used safely. Update the extension and try again.
connect_refused: You declined the connection in your wallet. Tap the wallet again if you want to retry.
